comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal; record adjusts grinder guards before startup.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate probes a recessed tab and pulls tool and wire together; record slides two guards to measured gaps and actuates a start control while observing clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective undamaged extraction; record requires both noncontact gaps in range before startup and hands clear of the turning wheel.
comparison.reason: Measured safety adjustment and precedence are unrelated to depinning mechanics.
